rules.statement: The breach of a covenant to keep property in good order does not entitle the lessee to equitable relief unless the penalty of forfeiture would be outrageous or immanis.
rules.supporting_quote: "No authority has been adduced to us, and I do not believe that any can be found, that in a case where there has been a breach of covenants to keep the property demised in good order, the lessee is entitled to equitable relief. The only ground, as far as I can see, on which he could claim such relief is that the penalty of forfeiture would be outrageous or immanis, in the language of the Roman-Dutch law, in the circumstances of the particular case."
